description: A control with exactly two options that switches the scope or the view of the same content.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: Segmented Control switches the scope or the view of the same content between exactly two options, like Store and Network or List and Calendar. One option is always selected, and the content below changes at once.
whenToUseItems: Two scopes of the same content, like one store or the whole network.
Two views of the same data, like a list or a calendar.
whenNotToUseItems: Sections with their own content: use [Tab](docs:components-tab--overview).
To filter one list (All, Pending, Paid): use the Filter Bar, [Chips](docs:components-chips--docs).
To turn a setting on or off: use [Switch](docs:components-switch--docs).
A choice inside a form: use [Radio](docs:components-radio--docs).
More than two options: use [Tab](docs:components-tab--overview) or the Filter Bar, [Chips](docs:components-chips--docs).

When the switch makes no sense for the person (like a store without a network): do not show the control. Use `disabled` only when the switch exists but is unavailable for now. There is no loading state.

formatting.title: Formatting
formatting.layoutText: The control is as wide as its two options; it does not stretch.
layoutRows: The labels fit|Each option as wide as its content; the control hugs the two options.
The labels do not fit the container|The control stops at the container width and the labels are cut with an ellipsis.
formatting.backgroundText: The control has two backgrounds. Pick the one that contrasts with the surface below it.
backgroundRows: White (`background="white"`)|color-interface-light-pure|Light up surfaces (`color-interface-light-up`), like cards and heros, where the default would disappear.

rows: 1|Control|Yes|Pill without border, around the two options; light up or white background.

3|Icon|No|16px, before the label, in the label color.

5|Counter|No|Small count Badge after the label: Primary Inverse on the selected option, Primary on the other, Neutral when disabled.

content.title: Content
content.text: Each option names one scope or one view of the same content.
writingItems: Name each option with one or two words, in sentence case.
Keep the two labels parallel: both nouns, about the same length.
Use the icon only when it helps tell the views apart, on both options.
content.useDo: Use the control to switch the scope or the view of the same content.
content.useDont: Do not use it to filter one list; use the Filter Bar ([Chips](docs:components-chips--docs)).

behaviors.title: Behaviors
behaviors.text: The state belongs to the whole control. Hover and keyboard focus change only the control background; keyboard focus looks exactly like hover, without a focus ring. On a change, the selection background slides to the new option in 300ms and the colors ease. With reduced motion the change is instant.

Focused (keyboard)|Light down, on both backgrounds|Primary|Same as default
Disabled|Light up (default) · White (white), no hover|Light down|Dark up on both options; Neutral counters

development.title: Development considerations
items: **Name the control.** Pass `aria-label` with what the options switch, like "Scope" or "View".
**Keep the selection in the screen.** Store `selectedIndex` in the screen state and update it in `onChange`.
**Focus has no ring.** Keyboard focus looks like hover, by design decision: the control background turns light down on both backgrounds.
**Pick the background by the surface.** Use `background="white"` on light up surfaces; the default disappears on them.
**Disabled or hidden.** Use `disabled` when the switch exists but is unavailable for now; when it makes no sense for the person, do not render the control.
